name: Shinkamigoto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shinkamigoto town emblem in light blue, green and pink: a light blue disc with white and green curved strokes and a pink disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shinkamigoto, a town in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 October 2004.

features.role: Shinkamigoto town emblem — a light blue disc with white and green curved strokes and a pink disc
